hints.title: Set Deduplication
hints.text: Convert both arrays nums1 and nums2 to unique sets s1 and s2.

hints.title: Distinct Disjoint Elements
hints.text: The first list consists of all elements in s1 that are not in s2.

hints.title: Complementary Difference
hints.text: The second list consists of all elements in s2 that are not in s1.

hints.title: Set Difference Construction

complexity.notes: Constructing sets and filtering differences operates in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching linearly for each element across the opposite array takes O(n1 * n2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash sets store unique elements from both arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate writes concise set operations with correct deduplication.
